answer: At dawn the harbor board opens 200 work slots. Claiming one locks a 25 POA deposit and a cipher naming the slot and job. A random auditor replays the cipher proof; a slot whose work never arrives or fails burns its deposit. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 25,000 POA burned per epoch, against a 30,000 POA pool, and fakes earn nothing without real work. An honest agent pays one deposit, keeps slot and full revenue: honesty costs 25, forgery a fortune.
